study.question: Does the exact committed compact-mean residual improve the stronger g0 pair-rank-occupancy representation beyond macro AUC 0.831886841754755, and beyond an equal-active-capacity DIN-summary replacement, under the frozen protocol?
study.hypothesis: The g0 global DIN sum uses target-dependent signed unnormalized weights. A separately normalized uniform mean of the same valid history values may preserve global behavior composition suppressed by these weights, complementing pair occupancy and field/feedback summary tokens. The shared, zero-start low-rank residual may improve all-task ranking without an event/query retrieval stack. The source score gap alone does not establish this mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the complete source representation and add only the committed compact terminal residual. The source remains the frozen utility/no-residual control.

Copy TaskRead, TaskMixer and TerminalRetrieval AST exactly, including historical construction/pruning to retain initialization. Transfer its active residual to g0; do not import its no-pair/separate bundle into the candidate.
Inherit local activation, embeddings and four-task heads through the committed sources; retain baseline as the initial quality/cost reference.

Original arXiv:2311.05884v1 sections3.1-3.5 inspected via https://arxiv.org/html/2311.05884v1. Heterogeneous/composite attention and low-rank/pruned task reads are established ideas. This implementation tests an inherited uniform residual alongside pair-occupancy summaries; no originality or full-paper reproduction claim.

Pinned forward lines113-159 pool history with target attention before field/task token interaction. Our candidate retains committed relation/pair summary tokens and adds a shared mean residual to a raw pooled feature, without changing attention parameterization.

inherited_components: Frozen source embeddings and DIN local activation over the six target/history item fields
35 temporal/relation summary tokens, full linear rank moments, residual and relation/content banks, factorized feedback-content bank
g0 conjunctive pair content/count and pair-rank occupancy banks, collapsed feedback memory, JointBlock and original four towers
Exact g1 compact residual initializer, valid-event uniform pooling,112->32->112 low-rank maps, non-affine LayerNorm,112->112 zero-initialized output map and empty-history gate
study.proposed_difference: Append the unmodified g1 compact residual after g0 source construction in a CPU RNG fork; add its update to the global DIN-sum portion of each tower input. All tasks receive the same residual summary/maps; this is not task-adaptive retrieval. Two controls replace its input by DIN at identical active capacity, and remove it from the g1 representation to complete a source-bundle-by-residual factorial with the frozen receipts.
predictions: pair_compact_mean exceeds both frozen source macro AUCs, specifically 0.831886841754755; record every task AUC and Logloss delta against DIN and both sources.
pair_compact_mean exceeds pair_compact_din if uniform history content supplies information or a useful optimization path beyond shared extra capacity.
The gain from mean versus no residual can differ between the two source bundles; evaluate the declared difference in differences without interpreting it as a pair-bank-only effect.

No speedup over g0 is presumed: the transferred path adds work and19,712 parameters. Measure train/wall/inference time, batch p50/p95, peak memory and parameter counts; compare observed quality/cost points.
The direct residual is exactly gated off on empty histories; retraining can still change empty-history predictions through shared learned weights.
falsifiers: Macro AUC at or below0.831886841754755 falsifies the predicted utility for the merged implementation.
No improvement over the equal-capacity DIN replacement fails to support a uniform-specific advantage.

A nonfinite forward/backward, dependence on masked item/action/task-mask entries, current-action sensitivity, source-replay mismatch, or protocol/hash mismatch invalidates a comparison until resolved within budget; it is not scientific counterevidence.
No positive bundle interaction fails to support the proposed synergy; positive simple effects without interaction would instead support additive transfer.
A quality gain with higher measured cost does not establish efficiency; without an equal-compute point report only the measured frontier trade-off.
